project.title: Comparative Analysis of Gut Bacterial Diversity in Three Medicinal Blister Beetle Species
project.description: Although the adults of three sympatric blister beetle species share some core bacterial genera, there are significant interspecific differences in their gut microbiota structure, biomarker taxa, and metabolic functions.
